raw_generation:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
NUMBER a = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
NUMBER c = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[2]).
NUMBER d = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[3]).
NUMBER[] values=[a,b,c,d].
NUMBER left=2.
NUMBER right=3.
LOOP (left<=right) { IF (values[left]*values[left]>4) { left+=1. } IF (values[right]*values[right]>4) { right-=1. } }
DISPLAYNL(right-left).

task_metadata.prompt: Read four pipe-separated numbers. Determine how many array positions satisfy the property entry whose square exceeds four. Print that count plus 2.
